i.norm: Tests that {@link LineIterator#next()} returns every line of a file, in order, and that {@link LineIterator#hasNext()} reports {@code false} once the file is exhausted.
Number of lines written to the test file.
Encoding passed to FileUtils; {@code null} means use the platform default.
Builds the expected line content, e.g. {@code ["LINE 0", "LINE 1", ...]}. @param lineCount number of lines to create. @return the generated lines.
Given: a file containing a known set of lines.
When / Then: next() yields each line in order, then no more remain.
Writes the given lines to the file using the default encoding. @param file target file. @param lines lines to write. @throws IOException if writing fails.
